_description: Customer loyalty segment distributions per zone. Used by historical agent for context-aware recommendations.
_usage: These distributions represent typical customer mix in each zone, helping inform loyalty-aware pricing strategies.

airport_corridor._description: Airport travelers - mix of business and leisure, higher loyalty rates
airport_corridor._notes: Business travelers often have higher loyalty tiers

downtown._description: Downtown urban core - diverse customer base
downtown._notes: Mix of regular commuters and occasional users

suburbs._description: Suburban zones - regular commuters, higher loyalty
suburbs._notes: Regular commuters build loyalty over time

venue._description: Generic venue - similar to stadium but slightly more regular users
venue._notes: Mix of event-goers and regular venue visitors

loyalty_discounts._description: Standard discount percentages applied per loyalty tier
loyalty_discounts._notes: Negative values indicate discounts (reductions in surge pricing)

loyalty_guardrails._description: Additional surge caps for loyal customers

platinum.description: Platinum members never pay more than +15% surge

standard.description: Standard members follow normal surge rules

_usage_examples: When computing historical factor, use zone distribution to weight recommendations
Example: airport_corridor has 18% platinum, so historical patterns should account for loyalty discounts
Loyalty discounts are applied AFTER computing base surge, then guardrails cap the final amount
